description: Show the standing risk profile of one file at HEAD: commit and bug-fix history, number of authors, direct and transitive dependents (blast radius; null when the language is not supported), whether it is on a critical or blocked path, and its top authors. Use it before editing a file you do not know, or to explain a high blast.dependents contribution.

path.description: Repo-relative file path with forward slashes, e.g. src/auth/session.ts.

repoDir.description: Absolute path to the git repository (any directory inside the work tree).

name: explain_file_risk
title: Explain file risk
